llm_response.reason: The website pretends to sell branded 'Elie Tahari' products, yet there is no evidence of official authorization or mention outside of its self-built pages. There are indications of copied text, urgency tactics ('Hot Sale'), promises of free shipping and guaranteed secure shopping with ambiguous company details, and the absence of company or review information elsewhere. All these fit hallmarks of fake online stores that do not fulfill orders or sell counterfeit goods.
